result.topic_en: Miscellaneous memoranda: a bibliographic note on Urban Jürgensen's book on precise timekeeping by clocks, addresses, a note on a court judgment in Göttingen in 1822, struck-through expense/appointment notes, and a Goethe quotation.

items.quote:
Das Prioritätsurtheil in der Adelepsi
schen Concurssache soll bei der
Justizcanzlei in Göttingen eröffnet
werden Donnerstag 9 May 1822.
items.english: The priority judgment in the Adelepsen bankruptcy case is to be opened at the Justice Chancellery in Göttingen on Thursday 9 May 1822.
Hinüber to be summoned/presented 22 Nov. at 11 in the morning.
